Container.Name: WavLM-Phoneme-Validator
Container.Overview: Phoneme-level pronunciation scoring as a REST API, built on the WavLM phoneme scorer (fine-tuned WavLM-Large, trained on 53,926 professionally labelled phonemes of children's English). Unlike a speech recogniser, which answers "what did you hear", this answers "how well was this specific expected phone produced" - so it can be given a canonical pronunciation and asked to grade audio against it. Intended as an advisory second validator alongside OpenPronounce. This GPU template is tuned for an NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti and persists the model cache in appdata.
Container.Changes: 1.0.1: Fix restricted Unraid startup, pin all models, bound decoding and reject incomplete assessments.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: pronunciation phoneme wavlm speech tts qa validation openpronounce kokoro
Container.Requires: The Unraid NVIDIA Driver plugin and a working NVIDIA container runtime. The first start downloads several gigabytes of model weights into appdata; the container reports healthy during that download but /api/v1/ready answers 503 until it finishes. Roughly 3 GB of VRAM is used once loaded, so check what else is on the card first.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: REST API and OpenAPI docs. 8005 avoids OpenPronounce on 8004 and Kokoro on 8880.

Config.Name: Persistent Configuration
Config.Description: Hugging Face model cache and torch cache. Several GB once populated; host directory must be owned by UID 99 / GID 100.

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: Optional shared secret. Clients may send X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer. Recommended outside a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Config.Description: Use all, a GPU index such as 0, or a GPU UUID from nvidia-smi -L.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: Capabilities required for CUDA inference and GPU status.

Config.Name: Torch Device
Config.Description: cuda for the selected NVIDIA GPU; use cpu only with the :cpu image.

Config.Name: Preload Models
Config.Description: Download and load the scorer in the background at startup instead of on the first request.

Config.Name: Maximum Concurrent Assessments
Config.Description: Keep at 1 on an 11 GB GTX 1080 Ti. Measure peak memory before increasing concurrency alongside other resident models.

Config.Name: Maximum Upload MB
Config.Description: Reject larger audio uploads before decoding.

Config.Name: Phoneme Error Threshold
Config.Description: Probability above which a phone is flagged as an error. 0.70 is the upstream calibration on children's speech; recalibrate for synthesized audio before trusting it.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated browser origins. Leave blank unless a web app calls this API directly.
